name: Dev-via-spec Builder → QA-Reviewer Handoff
description: When the dev-via-spec-builder terminates with builder_decide(action=tests_passing|tests_failing), this rule spawns the dev-via-spec-qa-reviewer (R3.7.2.j′ persona) to grade the build deliverable against the architect's commitments. R3.7.2.k′ of ADR-034. needs_clarification from the builder is intentionally NOT a trigger here — that's a chain-coverage gap the operator (today) or R3.5 coordinator-as-meta-reviewer (future) handles, not a build to review.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.dev-via-spec-qa-reviewer
on_enter.prompt:
The dev-via-spec-builder has terminated with builder_decide. Builder loop id: $entity.instance. Verdict: $entity.triple.coordinator.next_action. Reason: $entity.triple.coordinator.decision_reason.

Iteration 1 — call read_loop_result on $entity.instance to inspect the builder's structured terminal (action, tests_run, tests_passed, tests_failed, artifact_summary OR failure_summary + retry_hint).

Evidence summary (from the architect's verification_commitments[] graded against the builder's workspace):

```
(stub for R3.7.2.k′ — the evidence-rule registry exists in cmd/semteams/evidence/ as of R3.7.2.i′, and evidence.Summarize is the renderer, but the integration plumbing that runs the gate at builder-terminal time and substitutes the rendered output here is deferred. See project memory project_smoke7_open_plumbing.md §2 for the two viable shapes and the lean choice. Until that plumbing lands, treat the evidence summary as Empty Evidence per your 10-evaluation-contract.md Rule 3 — needs_clarification is the persona-correct verdict because the builder cannot fix this by retrying; the architect chain needs the gate plumbing to land.)
```

Iteration 2 — emit decide(action=accept|reject|needs_clarification, reason=<concrete>, blocking_question=<if needs_clarification>) per your 10-evaluation-contract.md three-rule grading. Until the evidence plumbing lands, the persona-correct path is decide(action=needs_clarification, reason="evidence summary not yet wired (R3.7.2.k′ stub)", blocking_question="<which integration shape lands next: rule action / tool / preprocessor>").

metadata.pattern: post-build review spawn — fires on the builder's tests_passing/tests_failing terminal and routes to the qa-reviewer persona (R3.7.2.j′). needs_clarification from the builder bypasses this rule by design (chain-coverage gap, not a buildable artifact).
metadata.evidence_summary_plumbing: The evidence_summary block in the spawn prompt is a literal stub for R3.7.2.k′ — sufficient to prove the chain shape end-to-end on mock-LLM. Real rendering (rule action, tool, or pre-publish preprocessor) lands in a follow-on slice. project_smoke7_open_plumbing.md §2 records the lean choice (rule action — gate is structural infra, not LLM-facing decision-making).
metadata.next_action_filter: tests_passing OR tests_failing only. needs_clarification from the builder is the persona-canonical boot-failure terminal (10-bash-iteration-contract.md Step 0); routing it back through qa-reviewer would mis-categorise wiring failure as build failure. R3.5 coordinator-as-meta-reviewer (ADR-031 §addendum 2026-05-02) is the right home for needs_clarification routing once it ships.
